written.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max flagship model
written.summary: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a new flagship 2.4T-parameter Mixture of Experts model featuring a 1-million-token context window. The company states it beats Qwen3.8-Max using up to ~50% fewer tokens.

written.headline: Trump administration plans to name AI "national champions"
written.summary: The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen artificial intelligence companies, including Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic, as "national champions." The program is designed to help U.S. firms expand overseas and compete with Chinese rivals.

written.headline: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress expected to rein in deals
written.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to rein in deals and slow AI investing after a period where Nvidia aggressively financed computing deals and startup investments. Neoclouds and related segments account for nearly half of Nvidia's revenue.

written.headline: Samsung SDS seeks Anthropic and OpenAI as tenants for AI data centre services
written.summary: Samsung’s IT arm, Samsung SDS, is in early talks to sign Anthropic and OpenAI as tenants for its AI data centre business, aiming to offer end‑to‑end building, operation and power services.

written.headline: Apple launches Health AI Usage Study app powered by OpenEvidence
written.summary: Apple launched the Health AI Usage Study app, developed with OpenEvidence, to examine how users interact with clinically grounded health answers. The study aims to enroll up to 200,000 U.S. participants for over 12 months.
